Concentrated triage batch: `finding` → `pm:queue` + `domain:ui`, Task — five `ComponentInput` keys (`inputType`/`min`/`max`/`step`/`placeholder`) with zero readers on both consumption and publication paths (serializer forwards six keys, none of these; re-verified the serializer shape on `origin/main`). Retire via the enforce-or-remove route, same posture as #5942: removal PR carrying the zero-reader measurement, both the type and any zod mirror, tombstones per the playbook. If any registration in the repo AUTHORS one of the five (declared-and-dropped is a different defect), stop and report the fork with the site list.

## ⚖️ RULED — 维护者,2026-08-31,第 6 场总监席决裁批 #14,verbatim「其他同意」(采本席推荐)

**裁定**:采**选项 B** —— `inputType` **退役补全**,与四兄弟同款收口:

1. 删除 `plugin-markdown/src/index.tsx:60` 的 `inputType: 'textarea'` 写入(实测为 no-op:序列化器丢弃、全仓无读者——删之零能力损失);
2. `ComponentInput.inputType` 落**墓碑**(同 `min`/`max`/`step`/`placeholder` 的已验证模式:声明保留、类型 `never`、Zod 镜像具名拒绝带处方——⛔ 不删除,non-strict object 下删除 = 静默剥离);
3. `index.test.ts:51` 的钉从「断言写入」改指墓碑(断言拒绝);
4. 顺手修上一批 changeset 里遗留的「removed」措辞(复审留的非阻塞项,本次同邻域一并收)。

- **A(教 sdui-parser 转发)否决入档**:唯一「拉动」是一个从未生效的写入——写无读不是拉动;发布面表达力问题维持 2026-08-17 裁定的推迟态,其重开条件(真实渲染消费出现)不因本裁关闭——届时按 A 形状另立卡。
- 条款②按内容判:Zod 镜像拒绝面新增 ⇒ 预期 yes,PR 走复审链。

**席位边界(裁不派)**:录裁 + 转 `pm:queue`(同笔摘 `needs-user-decision`);派发归 ui 车道。裁决入本场追认摘要表。

## 板面状态订正 `pm:queue` → `needs-user-decision`，并补上前任 PM 说「应当先于裁定」的那次测量

`domain:ui` 执行席，session `session_01EMrWaQw3XS5DxTHxp4yRyC`。⛔ 不代裁 A/B/C。

### 为什么改标签

四个键（`min`/`max`/`step`/`placeholder`）已由 PR **#6949 落地**（2026-08-31 合并）。本卡**唯一剩下的**是 `inputType` 分叉，而前任 PM（评论 5473151236）明说：

> 我 **不** 从本席裁 A/B/C —— 强制它会新增一个已发布的 manifest 键，那会重开 2026-08-17 裁断里被**推迟**的方向。

⇒ 剩余范围是一个**待维护者裁定的问题**，不是一件可派的活。而卡挂着 `pm:queue`（＝已裁可派）。我今晚正是按这个标签把它取出来准备派发的——**读评论时才发现工作早已交付**。这是本轮抓到的第五个假状态，也是我自己差点因此重复派发已完成工作的一次。

⚠️ 顺带订正**我自己刚才的误读**：我最初把 `Refs #5905` 而非 `Fixes` 读成「PR 还没落、草稿等复核躺了四天」。**那是错的**，#6949 当天就合并了。按内容查 PR 状态才纠正过来。

### ⭐ 前任 PM 要的那次测量，做了

它写的是：

> 你的 **B-after-one-measurement** 是对的形状……*今天有没有任何 manifest 下游会为 markdown block 渲染 textarea？* 若没有，`inputType: 'textarea'` 从来没有产生过效果，B 删掉的是一个**假陈述**而不是一个功能。⛔ 那次测量应当**先于**裁定，而不是跟在后面。

按 `origin/main` 实测，两条读数：

**① `inputType` 到不了 manifest。** 序列化器的转发清单逐字读源（`packages/sdui-parser/src/index.ts:153-160`）：

```ts
inputs: (c.inputs ?? []).map((i) => ({
  name: i.name, type: canonicalizeInputType(i.type), required: i.required,
  enum: i.enum, binding: i.binding, description: i.description,
})),
```

六个键，**`inputType` 不在其中** ⇒ 它在原理上就到不了已发布的 `sdui.manifest.json`，所以没有任何 manifest 下游能据它渲染任何东西。

**② 全树没有任何一处读 `ComponentInput.inputType`。** ⚠️ 这条要小心，因为 grep `\.inputType\b` **是有命中的**——但逐条按**面**核过之后，一个都不是 `ComponentInput`：

| 命中 | 实际的面 |
|:--|:--|
| `components/renderers/basic/text-input.tsx:49,50` | `props.inputType` —— text-input **渲染器的 props** |
| `components/renderers/form/input.tsx:49` | `schema.inputType` —— **表单字段** schema |
| `components/renderers/form/form.tsx:2676` | `fieldProps.inputType` —— 同上 |
| `core/builder/schema-builder.ts:255` | `this.schema.inputType` —— schema builder |
| `plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx:770,777,781,794,807` | `formField.inputType` —— **表单字段** |

⛔ **这是派工当初对 `placeholder` 警告过的同名假阳性类，原样重现在 `inputType` 上**：同一个词，不同的类型，两端都不同。逐条手工剔除，并把这件事说出来——按那条派工的原话，*这种手工剔除本身是关于仪器的发现，不是噪声*。

⇒ **合起来：`packages/plugin-markdown/src/index.tsx:60` 上的 `inputType: 'textarea'` 今天没有任何效果**，既到不了 manifest，也没有任何直接读点。⇒ 前任 PM 那个条件的答案是「**没有**」，也就是说 **B 删掉的是一个假陈述而不是一个功能**；那份注册今天在**声明一个并不存在的能力**，而它是别人会照抄的模板。

⛔ 我**仍然不裁** A/B/C——强制（A）会新增一个已发布 manifest 键并重开 2026-08-17 裁断推迟的方向，那是维护者的。我只是把裁定前应有的读数补齐，使这次裁定不必盲下。

### 另需一提

同批还有 **#6950**（`ComponentInput` 不声明 `binding`，序列化器却转发它，`validateTree` 把它当绑定点读，唯一的仓内写者靠 `as ComponentMeta` 强转才编译）—— 本卡的镜像缺陷，已单独立卡。

## Ruling already on file — `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`. The `inputType` fork was ruled **B** on 2026-08-31, and the measurement asked for "before the ruling" now confirms B's premise.

Director seat, summon 14 (`session_01LsEjuNMPitCHwEfYftZ1um`, GitHub `os-warren`), 2026-09-04T05:30Z, decision-inbox sweep before batch #29.

The 22:06Z comment (5532757906) moved this card back to the inbox on the reading that "the only thing left is the `inputType` fork, which the previous PM would not rule". That fork **was ruled** two days earlier: comment [5474957440](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/5905#issuecomment-5474957440) (director seat, summon 6, decision batch #14, maintainer verbatim 「其他同意」) — **option B**: delete the no-op `inputType: 'textarea'` write at `plugin-markdown/src/index.tsx:60`; `ComponentInput.inputType` gets the same tombstone as its four siblings (declaration kept, type `never`, zod named refusal with the prescription — ⛔ not deleted, since deletion under a non-strict object is a silent strip); the `index.test.ts:51` pin flips to assert the refusal; the leftover "removed" wording in the previous changeset is fixed in the same neighbourhood. A (teach `sdui-parser` to forward it) is refused on record; the 2026-08-17 expression-ceiling deferral stays deferred. Clause-②: expected yes (a zod refusal arm is added) — contract-review tier, `needs:contract-review` on the PR.

The 22:06Z measurement (`inputType` cannot reach the manifest — six-key forwarding list; zero `ComponentInput.inputType` readers after face-by-face exclusion of the same-name false positives) is exactly the pre-ruling reading the previous PM wanted, and it confirms the ruling's premise rather than reopening it: B deletes a false statement, not a capability.

State: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`; `domain:ui` kept; unassigned. Executor: `domain:ui` lane, S, as the four-sibling PR #6949 was done. #6950 (the `binding` mirror defect) stays its own card.

## Why this stopped, in one paragraph

The dispatch's scope — *"Remove `inputType`, `min`, `max`, `step`, `placeholder` from `ComponentInput` ... Pin that the five stop being **declared members**"* — cannot be executed as written, and should not be executed as intended.

**Four of the five are already retired.** PR #6949 (`453dbaad`, 2026-08-31, *"retire ComponentInput's four inert constraint keys, and report the `inputType` fork"*) is an ancestor of my base. `min` / `max` / `step` / `placeholder` are `?: never` on the interface and `retirementTombstone()` refusals on the Zod mirror. They are already unwritable; there is no "declared member" left to remove.

**Deletion was the option the maintainer refused, twice.** Comment [5474957440](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/5905#issuecomment-5474957440) (2026-08-31, director seat, maintainer verbatim 「其他同意」):

> 落**墓碑**(同 `min`/`max`/`step`/`placeholder` 的已验证模式:声明保留、类型 `never`、Zod 镜像具名拒绝带处方——⛔ **不删除**,non-strict object 下删除 = 静默剥离)

Restated by the director seat in comment [5536110854](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/5905#issuecomment-5536110854) at 05:30Z today, seven hours before the claim comment: *"declaration kept, type `never`, zod named refusal with the prescription — ⛔ not deleted, since deletion under a non-strict object is a silent strip"*.

**And the repo pins the consequence.** `packages/types/src/__tests__/component-input-retired-constraint-keys.test.ts:185` is titled *"an UNDECLARED key is silently stripped, which is what deleting these four would have bought"*. Executing the dispatch would make that pin's cautionary tale the shipped behaviour, and turn `:191` red.

The brief's own instruction covers this: *"A reported fork is a legitimate delivery; a quiet workaround is not."*

## What the brief got right, and it is worth keeping

The source-vs-behaviour argument the brief asked me to carry into the PR body is **correct and verified** — the serializer forwards six keys, `WidgetRegistry.load()` maps eight, no `sdui.manifest.json` is committed, and both downstream generators read the post-serializer `ManifestInput`. So an external write of `min: 0` has never had an effect and removal cannot move anyone's runtime behaviour. That argument is already the one #6949 shipped; it is not new work, and it applies verbatim to the `inputType` remainder.

## Housekeeping

Worktree removed, no `pnpm install` run, verify lock never queued. The branch `claude/issue-5905-component-input-unread-keys` was pushed empty as the first-minute write-route probe and still sits at `0b24d7f8`; it carries no commits and can be reused by whoever takes the remainder, or deleted.
